I need to write a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array of non-negative numbers, but caps the sum at a given positive limit. Once adding an element would exceed the cap, every subsequent position in the result should be set to the cap.

I drafted two implementations. One uses a boolean flag to freeze the total at the cap once exceeded. The simpler version uses `Math.min(total + num, cap)` on every step.
